title: Countersign configuration
description: Settings for the countersign approval panel, read from $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/countersign/config.json, or ~/.config/countersign/config.json when that variable is unset or empty.

durationText.description: A duration with a unit: ms, s, m or h, such as "500ms", "0.5s", "90s", "2m" or "1h". A bare number counts in the key's own unit.

tokenLadder.description: Three strictly ascending token counts: the soft, status and insist checkpoints.

enabled.description: Whether Countersign adds context checkpoint notes to a Claude Code session as its context grows.

mode.description: Whether a checkpoint asks you in a panel or only adds its note silently.

thresholds.description: Token counts of the three checkpoints, by context window size.

modelThresholds.description: Checkpoints for one model, keyed by its model identifier exactly as Claude Code reports it; they win over thresholds.

rearmBelow.description: Fraction of a checkpoint's token count the context must fall below, for example after /compact, before that checkpoint can fire again.

handoffFile.description: Path the handoff notes ask Claude to write, substituted for {handoffFile}.

notes.description: Text of each note; {tokens} becomes the context size, such as 212K, and {handoffFile} the handoff path.

soft.description: The note sent at the first checkpoint.

status.description: The note sent at the second checkpoint.

insist.description: The note sent at the third checkpoint.

compact.description: The note sent when you choose to compact.

handoff.description: The note sent when you choose to hand off.

menuBarMeter.description: Whether the menu-bar companion shows the context size of the active Claude Code session.

hosts.description: Per-host overrides; context checkpoints support only Claude Code.

armDelay.description: Time the panel ignores input after appearing, for this host: a number of seconds, or a string with a unit such as "500ms"; out-of-range values are clamped to 0...3 seconds.

chainedArmDelay.description: Time a panel ignores input when it appears right after the previous panel was answered, for this host; every other panel uses armDelay. A number of seconds, or a string with a unit such as "100ms"; out-of-range values are clamped to 0...3 seconds.

idleSeconds.description: Time of no keyboard, mouse or held-modifier activity required before a panel is shown, for this host, from 1 to 30 seconds: a number of seconds, or a string with a unit such as "500ms" or "2s".

graceSeconds.description: Time a hook waits for its request to resolve elsewhere before it queues a panel, for this host, from 0 to 30 seconds: a number of seconds, or a string with a unit such as "500ms" or "2s".

handoffApps.description: Bundle identifiers that silently hand a request off, with no panel, when frontmost, for this host.

snoozeMinutes.description: Durations in menu order, from 10 seconds to 24 hours, offered by the panel's Snooze menu, for this host; each is a number of minutes or a string with a unit such as "30s" or "1h".

includeHeadlessSessions.description: Whether a non-interactive Claude Code session, such as claude -p, still gets a panel instead of being skipped, for this host; no effect for Codex, Cursor or Antigravity.

approvalCard.description: Whether a corner card with a Show button appears when this host's approval has been waiting approvalCardDelay seconds while you keep working. Defaults to the top-level approvalCard, then on for Codex, Cursor and Antigravity and off for Claude Code.

approvalCardDelay.description: How long an approval waits for a pause in your typing before its card appears, from 1 second to 10 minutes: a number of seconds, or a string with a unit such as "5s" or "2m"; for this host.

waitingNoticeDelay.description: How long an agent has been waiting before the notice appears, from 10 seconds to 1 hour: a number of seconds, or a string with a unit such as "10s" or "2m"; for this host.

$schema.description: A JSON Schema reference for editor validation; ignored by countersign itself.

armDelay.description: Time the panel ignores input after appearing: a number of seconds, or a string with a unit such as "500ms"; out-of-range values are clamped to 0...3 seconds.

chainedArmDelay.description: Time a panel ignores input when it appears right after the previous panel was answered; every other panel uses armDelay. A number of seconds, or a string with a unit such as "100ms"; out-of-range values are clamped to 0...3 seconds.

idleSeconds.description: Time of no keyboard, mouse or held-modifier activity required before a panel is shown, from 1 to 30 seconds: a number of seconds, or a string with a unit such as "500ms" or "2s".

graceSeconds.description: Time a hook waits for its request to resolve elsewhere before it queues a panel, from 0 to 30 seconds: a number of seconds, or a string with a unit such as "500ms" or "2s".

handoffApps.description: Bundle identifiers that silently hand a request off, with no panel, when frontmost.

snoozeMinutes.description: Durations in menu order, from 10 seconds to 24 hours, offered by the panel's Snooze menu; each is a number of minutes or a string with a unit such as "30s" or "1h".

days.description: The days a window starts on.

from.description: Local start time, such as 9, 9:30, 930 or 09:30.

to.description: Local end time, such as 9, 9:30, 930 or 09:30, different from the start. Earlier than the start means the window runs past midnight.

quietHours.description: Recurring windows in which panels wait, like a snooze that repeats; top level only.

decision.description: Whether a matching request is answered with allow or deny without a panel.

agent.description: Limits the rule to one agent; leave out for all four.

project.description: Limits the rule to requests whose working directory is this folder or inside it; an absolute path or one starting with ~.

tool.description: Limits the rule to tools whose name matches; * is the only wildcard, as in mcp__github__*.

command.description: Limits the rule to shell commands matching this pattern: a command prefix such as "git status", or a base and argument glob such as "npm:*".

message.description: Deny rules only: the reason shown to the agent; defaults to "Denied by a Countersign rule.".

rules.description: Countersign's own allow and deny rules, checked before a panel shows. Deny wins; a compound command is allowed only when every part is.

checkForUpdates.description: Whether the menu-bar companion checks for a newer release on its own, at most once every 24 hours; top level only.

showSkills.description: Show the Skills group, which lists what countersign-skills installed. Turn it off to hide the group; top level only.

quitBehavior.description: What quitting the menu-bar companion from its menu does: ask each time, quit and keep showing panels, or quit and pause panels until Countersign opens again; top level only.

modeAfterPlan.description: What Claude Code switches to when you approve its plan.

panelSound.description: A system sound played once when a panel appears, except the next panel in a chain of answers; none plays nothing; top level only.

waitingNotices.description: Whether a corner card appears when an agent has been waiting for you; setup adds the Stop hook while it is on, and turning it off from Settings removes it; top level only.

waitingNoticeDelay.description: How long an agent has been waiting before the notice appears, from 10 seconds to 1 hour: a number of seconds, or a string with a unit such as "10s" or "2m"; hosts.<agent>.waitingNoticeDelay overrides it per agent.

waitingNoticeDuration.description: How long a waiting-agent notice stays on screen before it closes by itself, from 3 seconds to 1 hour: a number of seconds, or a string with a unit such as "10s" or "1m". Only visible time counts.

approvalCard.description: Whether a corner card with a Show button appears when an approval has been waiting approvalCardDelay seconds while you keep working. Unset, it is on for Codex, Cursor and Antigravity and off for Claude Code; hosts.<agent>.approvalCard overrides it per agent.

approvalCardDelay.description: How long an approval waits for a pause in your typing before its card appears, from 1 second to 10 minutes: a number of seconds, or a string with a unit such as "5s" or "2m".

includeHeadlessSessions.description: Whether a non-interactive Claude Code session, such as claude -p, still gets a panel instead of being skipped; no effect for Codex, Cursor or Antigravity.

questionNotes.description: Whether the question panel offers a note to attach to the option you pick, sent back as annotations; top level only.

appearance.description: Whether panels and the Settings window follow the macOS appearance or stay light or dark; top level only.

accentColor.description: The accent color of Approve and highlights on panels and in the Settings window, as #RRGGBB; text in it is darkened or lightened until it reads at 4.5:1. Top level only.

editorApp.description: Bundle identifier of the app Open in Editor opens config.json with; absent uses the default app macOS would open it with; top level only.

contextCheckpoints.description: Optional notes that ask Claude Code to wrap up, compact or hand off as its context grows; on by default, Claude Code only.

hosts.description: Per-host overrides for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity.
